item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find reliable 2024 evidence that Biden systematically filled government with donors, business associates, or business cronies, or that close family profited through contracts, monopolies, bribes, emoluments, or opaque foundations. The strongest negative material is narrower: a loyal inner circle, family proximity, and the Hunter pardon. The strongest positive material is procedural and staffing-oriented: merit-based awards, competitive grantmaking, and at least one clear technocratic appointment.","evidence":[{"title":"CHIPS award followed due diligence and milestone conditions","publisher":"U.S. Department of Commerce","date":"2024-12-20","url":"https://www.commerce.gov/news/press-releases/2024/12/biden-harris-administration-announces-chips-incentives-award-samsung","summary":"The Samsung CHIPS award says Commerce completed due diligence and will distribute funds based on project milestones.
